about: Every recorded production Firestore Enterprise text-search case replayed through the local engine: membership for every case, result order for every case with two or more results (score-sorted and default), and Boundary03 membership for both rounds. expected is the production response (order kept where it has two or more results), actual the local answer. Numeric score() values are not compared.
